title: Subquery in FROM
prompt: Count patients per hospital_id using a subquery in FROM (derived table). Return hospital_id and patient_count.
starterSql:
SELECT hospital_id, patient_count
FROM (
  SELECT hospital_id, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
  FROM patients
  GROUP BY hospital_id
) AS counts
hints: Subquery in FROM must have an alias (AS counts).
Outer SELECT reads from the inner result.

validation.solutionSql: SELECT hospital_id, patient_count FROM (SELECT hospital_id, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY hospital_id) AS counts
